name: Build a Bridge
desc:
🌉 BUILD A BRIDGE - CAN IT HOLD? 🌉

Build your own bridge, send traffic across and earn cash from every vehicle that makes it to the other side! 💰

⚠️ REAL BRIDGE PHYSICS ⚠️
Every beam takes real weight. Your bridge bends under each vehicle, and if it is too weak it snaps and falls into the water! 💥

🔨 HOW TO PLAY
🛣️ Draw your road across the gap
🔩 Add Wood, Steel and Titanium supports
🚗 Watch traffic cross and earn cash
⬆️ Unlock bigger, heavier vehicles
🔄 Rebirth for a wider gap and more income

🚚 FEATURES
🛵 16 vehicles, from a tiny Scooter to the massive Heavy Hauler
📐 Stuck? Get a blueprint from the Builder and trace it
✨ Rare Golden, Diamond, Fire, Rainbow and Galaxy vehicles
⚡ Upgrade your vehicle speed and spawn rate
💤 Earn cash while offline
🏆 Climb the leaderboards

Will your bridge hold, or will it collapse? 👀

llm.loop: draw road across gap -> add wood/steel/titanium supports -> traffic crosses and pays cash -> unlock heavier vehicles -> rebirth for wider gap
llm.objectives: build a bridge strong enough to carry ever-heavier traffic
llm.progression: cash, vehicle tiers, materials, rebirths, offline cash
llm.instructions: draw road across the gap, add supports, watch traffic cross for cash, unlock bigger vehicles, rebirth for a wider gap; trace blueprints if stuck
unique: real load physics bridge construction (Poly Bridge-like) wrapped in an idle tycoon
llm.thumbnails: blueprint-style bridge with builder avatar; plank over a gap
llm.complexity_notes: beam stress physics, drawing tool, vehicle spawning
